meta.title: Mysterious Map
meta.description: A mysterious map and a marvelous tale.

units.rawText: The fragile little maiden is particularly distinctive among the sailors who are hard at work. She tries to speak to them several times but doesn't dare make a sound until one of them stops in front of her.
units.displayText: The fragile little maiden is particularly distinctive among the sailors who are hard at work. She tries to speak to them several times but doesn't dare make a sound until one of them stops in front of her.

spans.text: The fragile little maiden is particularly distinctive among the sailors who are hard at work. She tries to speak to them several times but doesn't dare make a sound until one of them stops in front of her.

units.rawText: Miss? What are you doing here? This isn't a place for kids like you.
units.displayText: Miss? What are you doing here? This isn't a place for kids like you.

spans.text: Miss? What are you doing here? This isn't a place for kids like you.

units.rawText: Hello...
units.displayText: Hello...

spans.text: Hello...

units.rawText: Ah... I'm looking for Captain <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Ah... I'm looking for Captain {교수}.

spans.text: Ah... I'm looking for Captain

units.rawText: Hm? You're here looking for the Cap'n too?
units.displayText: Hm? You're here looking for the Cap'n too?

spans.text: Hm? You're here looking for the Cap'n too?

units.rawText: Well, isn't that strange. There was a white-haired lady dressed all in black who came asking about the Cap just now.
units.displayText: Well, isn't that strange. There was a white-haired lady dressed all in black who came asking about the Cap just now.

spans.text: Well, isn't that strange. There was a white-haired lady dressed all in black who came asking about the Cap just now.

units.rawText: There's something... Ah... and it needs Captain <cmdr>'s help! Could you please tell me where they are?
units.displayText: There's something... Ah... and it needs Captain {교수}'s help! Could you please tell me where they are?

spans.text: There's something... Ah... and it needs Captain
's help! Could you please tell me where they are?

units.rawText: Oh, I get it. You're planning on heading to the Strange Blue. Missy, I advise you not to do something so risky.
units.displayText: Oh, I get it. You're planning on heading to the Strange Blue. Missy, I advise you not to do something so risky.

spans.text: Oh, I get it. You're planning on heading to the Strange Blue. Missy, I advise you not to do something so risky.

units.rawText: There are hundreds, if not thousands of ships casting off from this port every day, but almost none of them have ever returned from the Strange Blue.
units.displayText: There are hundreds, if not thousands of ships casting off from this port every day, but almost none of them have ever returned from the Strange Blue.

spans.text: There are hundreds, if not thousands of ships casting off from this port every day, but almost none of them have ever returned from the Strange Blue.

units.rawText: Even the Royal Fleet went missing in the Strange Blue once. A scary place like that isn't something you can reach with a "by-your-leave" and "would-you-kindly".
units.displayText: Even the Royal Fleet went missing in the Strange Blue once. A scary place like that isn't something you can reach with a "by-your-leave" and "would-you-kindly".

spans.text: Even the Royal Fleet went missing in the Strange Blue once. A scary place like that isn't something you can reach with a "by-your-leave" and "would-you-kindly".

units.rawText: But you are the sole exception, are you not, Captain <cmdr>?
units.displayText: But you are the sole exception, are you not, Captain {교수}?

spans.text: But you are the sole exception, are you not, Captain

units.rawText: Ehhh!? YOU'RE the Captain!?
units.displayText: Ehhh!? YOU'RE the Captain!?

spans.text: Ehhh!? YOU'RE the Captain!?

units.rawText: So you were the one showing this kid the way. No wonder she found me.
units.displayText: So you were the one showing this kid the way. No wonder she found me.

spans.text: So you were the one showing this kid the way. No wonder she found me.

units.rawText: It's been a while, Witch. What prophecies do you bring this time? Sea monsters, maybe? Or a ghost ship?
units.displayText: It's been a while, Witch. What prophecies do you bring this time? Sea monsters, maybe? Or a ghost ship?

spans.text: It's been a while, Witch. What prophecies do you bring this time? Sea monsters, maybe? Or a ghost ship?

units.rawText: Humph. Allow me to introduce you to this girl. Her name is Helix. She's run into some difficulty, and she needs your help.
units.displayText: Humph. Allow me to introduce you to this girl. Her name is Helix. She's run into some difficulty, and she needs your help.

spans.text: Humph. Allow me to introduce you to this girl. Her name is Helix. She's run into some difficulty, and she needs your help.

units.rawText: P-p-p-p-p-pleased to meet you!
units.displayText: P-p-p-p-p-pleased to meet you!

spans.text: P-p-p-p-p-pleased to meet you!

units.rawText: And this is the only ship's captain who's ever come back safely from the Strange Blue. Though they're by no means decent and are fond of bragging and spouting nonsense...
units.displayText: And this is the only ship's captain who's ever come back safely from the Strange Blue. Though they're by no means decent and are fond of bragging and spouting nonsense...

spans.text: And this is the only ship's captain who's ever come back safely from the Strange Blue. Though they're by no means decent and are fond of bragging and spouting nonsense...

units.rawText: Mysterious, unscrupulous, scheming, with countless enemies...
units.displayText: Mysterious, unscrupulous, scheming, with countless enemies...

spans.text: Mysterious, unscrupulous, scheming, with countless enemies...

units.rawText: In addition to being incredibly shrewd and delighting in bamboozling others...
units.displayText: In addition to being incredibly shrewd and delighting in bamboozling others...

spans.text: In addition to being incredibly shrewd and delighting in bamboozling others...

units.rawText: As the witch's description grows stranger and stranger, I put my miniature down and raise my hand, signaling a temporary halt to the game.
units.displayText: As the witch's description grows stranger and stranger, I put my miniature down and raise my hand, signaling a temporary halt to the game.

spans.text: As the witch's description grows stranger and stranger, I put my miniature down and raise my hand, signaling a temporary halt to the game.

units.rawText: Excuse me, Antonina...
units.displayText: Excuse me, Antonina...

spans.text: Excuse me, Antonina...

units.rawText: Hm? Is there a problem, dear player?
units.displayText: Hm? Is there a problem, dear player?

spans.text: Hm? Is there a problem, dear player?

options.rawText: Why does it feel like you have it in for me?
options.displayText: Why does it feel like you have it in for me?

spans.text: Why does it feel like you have it in for me?

options.rawText: The character description clearly says I'm supposed to be a wise, valorous, and highly experienced captain.
options.displayText: The character description clearly says I'm supposed to be a wise, valorous, and highly experienced captain.

spans.text: The character description clearly says I'm supposed to be a wise, valorous, and highly experienced captain.

units.rawText: How could that be? I would NEVER use my position as a gamemaster to tease you, Professor.
units.displayText: How could that be? I would NEVER use my position as a gamemaster to tease you, Professor.

spans.text: How could that be? I would NEVER use my position as a gamemaster to tease you, Professor.

units.rawText: Your caring assistant Antonina reserves the right to interpret your character as she sees fit~
units.displayText: Your caring assistant Antonina reserves the right to interpret your character as she sees fit~

spans.text: Your caring assistant Antonina reserves the right to interpret your character as she sees fit~

units.rawText: ...You do seem to be having a bit too much fun with this, though.
units.displayText: ...You do seem to be having a bit too much fun with this, though.

spans.text: ...You do seem to be having a bit too much fun with this, though.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Professor. I'll make sure to treat you fairly... <size=28>I guess.</size>
units.displayText: Don't worry, Professor. I'll make sure to treat you fairly... I guess.

spans.text: Don't worry, Professor. I'll make sure to treat you fairly...
I guess.

units.rawText: I heard that!
units.displayText: I heard that!

spans.text: I heard that!

units.rawText: In any case, on with the story...
units.displayText: In any case, on with the story...

spans.text: In any case, on with the story...

units.rawText: Back on the deck, the Princess grasps at the hems of her dress.
units.displayText: Back on the deck, the Princess grasps at the hems of her dress.

spans.text: Back on the deck, the Princess grasps at the hems of her dress.

units.rawText: H-h-h hello! So, so you were Captain <cmdr> after all...
units.displayText: H-h-h hello! So, so you were Captain {교수} after all...

spans.text: H-h-h hello! So, so you were Captain
after all...

units.rawText: Ack, I bit my tongue...
units.displayText: Ack, I bit my tongue...

spans.text: Ack, I bit my tongue...
(Give a serious performance.)

options.rawText: (Mess around a little with your delivery.)
options.displayText: (Mess around a little with your delivery.)

spans.text: (Mess around a little with your delivery.)

units.rawText: Calm down, Miss. Why were you looking for me?
units.displayText: Calm down, Miss. Why were you looking for me?

spans.text: Calm down, Miss. Why were you looking for me?

units.rawText: Indeed, I am the wise, valorous, and extraordinary captain—<cmdr>!
units.displayText: Indeed, I am the wise, valorous, and extraordinary captain—{교수}!

spans.text: Indeed, I am the wise, valorous, and extraordinary captain—

units.rawText: I have never seen a more shameless person in my entire life.
units.displayText: I have never seen a more shameless person in my entire life.

spans.text: I have never seen a more shameless person in my entire life.

units.rawText: Hey, I'm just playing my character as the notes state.
units.displayText: Hey, I'm just playing my character as the notes state.

spans.text: Hey, I'm just playing my character as the notes state.

units.rawText: Ah... Um... Miss Witch told me that, that you, you could take me... To the Deep Sea Cavern.
units.displayText: Ah... Um... Miss Witch told me that, that you, you could take me... To the Deep Sea Cavern.

spans.text: Ah... Um... Miss Witch told me that, that you, you could take me... To the Deep Sea Cavern.

units.rawText: The Deep Sea Cavern? Where is that?
units.displayText: The Deep Sea Cavern? Where is that?

spans.text: The Deep Sea Cavern? Where is that?

units.rawText: It is a cave that slumbers in the depths of the Strange Blue.
units.displayText: It is a cave that slumbers in the depths of the Strange Blue.

spans.text: It is a cave that slumbers in the depths of the Strange Blue.

units.rawText: The Strange Blue... So it's there. Do you know how hard it is to find a cave in the Strange Blue? More to the point, do you even know how many people can enter the Strange Blue safely?
units.displayText: The Strange Blue... So it's there. Do you know how hard it is to find a cave in the Strange Blue? More to the point, do you even know how many people can enter the Strange Blue safely?

spans.text: The Strange Blue... So it's there. Do you know how hard it is to find a cave in the Strange Blue? More to the point, do you even know how many people can enter the Strange Blue safely?

units.rawText: That's why I need your help. Not to mention, this girl has something all you mariners have dreamed of.
units.displayText: That's why I need your help. Not to mention, this girl has something all you mariners have dreamed of.

spans.text: That's why I need your help. Not to mention, this girl has something all you mariners have dreamed of.

units.rawText: I only managed to escape the Strange Blue by sheer luck... But what's this thing you're saying all seafarers want?
units.displayText: I only managed to escape the Strange Blue by sheer luck... But what's this thing you're saying all seafarers want?

spans.text: I only managed to escape the Strange Blue by sheer luck... But what's this thing you're saying all seafarers want?

units.rawText: It's... It's the legendary sea map of the Strange Blue, said to have been left behind by the first people to discover it.
units.displayText: It's... It's the legendary sea map of the Strange Blue, said to have been left behind by the first people to discover it.

spans.text: It's... It's the legendary sea map of the Strange Blue, said to have been left behind by the first people to discover it.

units.rawText: (Sucks in breath) ...That's definitely something any man of the sea would dream of possessing.
units.displayText: (Sucks in breath) ...That's definitely something any man of the sea would dream of possessing.

spans.text: (Sucks in breath) ...That's definitely something any man of the sea would dream of possessing.

units.rawText: It seems you are discussing something very interesting. May I interject?
units.displayText: It seems you are discussing something very interesting. May I interject?

spans.text: It seems you are discussing something very interesting. May I interject?

units.rawText: Who're you?
units.displayText: Who're you?

spans.text: Who're you?

units.rawText: A woman in a priestess outfit has come aboard my ship at some point, dragging a coffin behind her.
units.displayText: A woman in a priestess outfit has come aboard my ship at some point, dragging a coffin behind her.

spans.text: A woman in a priestess outfit has come aboard my ship at some point, dragging a coffin behind her.

units.rawText: I didn't expect you to come too.
units.displayText: I didn't expect you to come too.

spans.text: I didn't expect you to come too.

units.rawText: Meeting you today must have been the work of Destiny. I am very interested in your discussion. Do you mind if I listen in?
units.displayText: Meeting you today must have been the work of Destiny. I am very interested in your discussion. Do you mind if I listen in?

spans.text: Meeting you today must have been the work of Destiny. I am very interested in your discussion. Do you mind if I listen in?

options.rawText: Most people wouldn't be too interested in a sea map.
options.displayText: Most people wouldn't be too interested in a sea map.

spans.text: Most people wouldn't be too interested in a sea map.
And who might you be?

units.rawText: Pardon me. I am Clotho. I am searching for the way to the Strange Blue for personal reasons.
units.displayText: Pardon me. I am Clotho. I am searching for the way to the Strange Blue for personal reasons.

spans.text: Pardon me. I am Clotho. I am searching for the way to the Strange Blue for personal reasons.

units.rawText: I am Clotho, a mere passing-through priestess. There is no need to remember my name.
units.displayText: I am Clotho, a mere passing-through priestess. There is no need to remember my name.

spans.text: I am Clotho, a mere passing-through priestess. There is no need to remember my name.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: This is your map, so naturally you should decide what to do with it. I am simply responsible for guiding you to someone who can understand this map.
units.displayText: This is your map, so naturally you should decide what to do with it. I am simply responsible for guiding you to someone who can understand this map.

spans.text: This is your map, so naturally you should decide what to do with it. I am simply responsible for guiding you to someone who can understand this map.

units.rawText: (Whimper) ...Actually, I can't really read this map myself.
units.displayText: (Whimper) ...Actually, I can't really read this map myself.

spans.text: (Whimper) ...Actually, I can't really read this map myself.

units.rawText: Helix takes out a sea map that looks like it's made of silk. It seems to be a prop that Antonina had prepared beforehand.
units.displayText: Helix takes out a sea map that looks like it's made of silk. It seems to be a prop that Antonina had prepared beforehand.

spans.text: Helix takes out a sea map that looks like it's made of silk. It seems to be a prop that Antonina had prepared beforehand.

units.rawText: It looks like an ancient nautical map. Hm? There seems to be a few special marks on it.
units.displayText: It looks like an ancient nautical map. Hm? There seems to be a few special marks on it.

spans.text: It looks like an ancient nautical map. Hm? There seems to be a few special marks on it.

units.rawText: It is woven of silk. From the wear, it appears to be hundreds of years old.
units.displayText: It is woven of silk. From the wear, it appears to be hundreds of years old.

spans.text: It is woven of silk. From the wear, it appears to be hundreds of years old.

units.rawText: Hm, it's also drawn in a very interesting way. Both the courses for entering the Strange Blue and sailing within the Strange Blue have been marked separately...
units.displayText: Hm, it's also drawn in a very interesting way. Both the courses for entering the Strange Blue and sailing within the Strange Blue have been marked separately...

spans.text: Hm, it's also drawn in a very interesting way. Both the courses for entering the Strange Blue and sailing within the Strange Blue have been marked separately...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Captain <cmdr>, is something the matter?
units.displayText: Captain {교수}, is something the matter?

spans.text: Captain
, is something the matter?

units.rawText: Something's not right about this... Let me see.
units.displayText: Something's not right about this... Let me see.

spans.text: Something's not right about this... Let me see.

units.rawText: I take an ordinary map out of my cabin and line the two maps up side by side.
units.displayText: I take an ordinary map out of my cabin and line the two maps up side by side.

spans.text: I take an ordinary map out of my cabin and line the two maps up side by side.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Looks like you noticed the problem too, Miss Priestess.
units.displayText: Looks like you noticed the problem too, Miss Priestess.

spans.text: Looks like you noticed the problem too, Miss Priestess.

units.rawText: The intersecting lines lead to the final destination known as Death.
units.displayText: The intersecting lines lead to the final destination known as Death.

spans.text: The intersecting lines lead to the final destination known as Death.

units.rawText: Eh? What... What does that mean?
units.displayText: Eh? What... What does that mean?

spans.text: Eh? What... What does that mean?

units.rawText: This map I took out is a sea map that we mariners have spent hundreds of years drawing and refining. But this map has discrepancies with the one you showed us.
units.displayText: This map I took out is a sea map that we mariners have spent hundreds of years drawing and refining. But this map has discrepancies with the one you showed us.

spans.text: This map I took out is a sea map that we mariners have spent hundreds of years drawing and refining. But this map has discrepancies with the one you showed us.

units.rawText: For instance, if we followed the first course plotted by your map on the current map...
units.displayText: For instance, if we followed the first course plotted by your map on the current map...

spans.text: For instance, if we followed the first course plotted by your map on the current map...

units.rawText: Ah! Your map has an extra island on it...
units.displayText: Ah! Your map has an extra island on it...

spans.text: Ah! Your map has an extra island on it...

units.rawText: That's right. If we sailed according to your map, we'd probably be blocked by this string of islands.
units.displayText: That's right. If we sailed according to your map, we'd probably be blocked by this string of islands.

spans.text: That's right. If we sailed according to your map, we'd probably be blocked by this string of islands.

units.rawText: And if we followed the other course... We'd run ashore on the shallows.
units.displayText: And if we followed the other course... We'd run ashore on the shallows.

spans.text: And if we followed the other course... We'd run ashore on the shallows.

units.rawText: But... but how...
units.displayText: But... but how...

spans.text: But... but how...

units.rawText: This map is well made, but unfortunately, everything recorded on it is wrong.
units.displayText: This map is well made, but unfortunately, everything recorded on it is wrong.

spans.text: This map is well made, but unfortunately, everything recorded on it is wrong.

units.rawText: The truth is hidden in the darkness, unfathomable.
units.displayText: The truth is hidden in the darkness, unfathomable.

spans.text: The truth is hidden in the darkness, unfathomable.

units.rawText: Is... is this map a fake?
units.displayText: Is... is this map a fake?

spans.text: Is... is this map a fake?

units.rawText: Or perhaps we haven't found the key to reading it yet...
units.displayText: Or perhaps we haven't found the key to reading it yet...

spans.text: Or perhaps we haven't found the key to reading it yet...

units.rawText: Then, then I, I, I won't be able to go to the Deep Sea Cavern... What... What should I do?
units.displayText: Then, then I, I, I won't be able to go to the Deep Sea Cavern... What... What should I do?

spans.text: Then, then I, I, I won't be able to go to the Deep Sea Cavern... What... What should I do?

units.rawText: Actually, I'm curious—Why do you want to go to this Deep Sea Cavern?
units.displayText: Actually, I'm curious—Why do you want to go to this Deep Sea Cavern?

spans.text: Actually, I'm curious—Why do you want to go to this Deep Sea Cavern?

units.rawText: And I'm also curious as to how you came by this map. To my knowledge, only the Kingdom's fleet uses such detailed maps.
units.displayText: And I'm also curious as to how you came by this map. To my knowledge, only the Kingdom's fleet uses such detailed maps.

spans.text: And I'm also curious as to how you came by this map. To my knowledge, only the Kingdom's fleet uses such detailed maps.

units.rawText: I... I'm Princess Helix of the Kingdom. There's... There's something I need in the Deep Sea Cavern.
units.displayText: I... I'm Princess Helix of the Kingdom. There's... There's something I need in the Deep Sea Cavern.

spans.text: I... I'm Princess Helix of the Kingdom. There's... There's something I need in the Deep Sea Cavern.

units.rawText: The Princess? Well, if you're the Princess... Then why would you need a commoner captain like me? Surely there must have been ships among the Royal Fleet who've returned from the Strange Blue, right?
units.displayText: The Princess? Well, if you're the Princess... Then why would you need a commoner captain like me? Surely there must have been ships among the Royal Fleet who've returned from the Strange Blue, right?

spans.text: The Princess? Well, if you're the Princess... Then why would you need a commoner captain like me? Surely there must have been ships among the Royal Fleet who've returned from the Strange Blue, right?

units.rawText: Um... Ah... I can't say...
units.displayText: Um... Ah... I can't say...

spans.text: Um... Ah... I can't say...

units.rawText: What lies within the cave?
units.displayText: What lies within the cave?

spans.text: What lies within the cave?

units.rawText: Something very important... And, and also... There's a lot of chweashure... Ack!
units.displayText: Something very important... And, and also... There's a lot of chweashure... Ack!

spans.text: Something very important... And, and also... There's a lot of chweashure... Ack!

units.rawText: She bit her tongue again, right? Right? Treasure became "chweashure" and all!
units.displayText: She bit her tongue again, right? Right? Treasure became "chweashure" and all!

spans.text: She bit her tongue again, right? Right? Treasure became "chweashure" and all!

units.rawText: I-I-I-I-I-I'm sorry!
units.displayText: I-I-I-I-I-I'm sorry!

spans.text: I-I-I-I-I-I'm sorry!

units.rawText: Helix's face flushes pink, and I can practically see the steam clouds coming from her overheating neural cloud.
units.displayText: Helix's face flushes pink, and I can practically see the steam clouds coming from her overheating neural cloud.

spans.text: Helix's face flushes pink, and I can practically see the steam clouds coming from her overheating neural cloud.

units.rawText: Helix, you've been very nervous since just now. Why is that?
units.displayText: Helix, you've been very nervous since just now. Why is that?

spans.text: Helix, you've been very nervous since just now. Why is that?

units.rawText: That... That's because it's my first time playing a game with you, Professor, so I wanted to do my best.
units.displayText: That... That's because it's my first time playing a game with you, Professor, so I wanted to do my best.

spans.text: That... That's because it's my first time playing a game with you, Professor, so I wanted to do my best.

units.rawText: But... But I can't get into character like everyone else can...
units.displayText: But... But I can't get into character like everyone else can...

spans.text: But... But I can't get into character like everyone else can...

units.rawText: Relax, Helix. In an RPG, everyone has their own way of playing and roleplaying. You don't need to get too caught up in the sample lines your character folio gave you.
units.displayText: Relax, Helix. In an RPG, everyone has their own way of playing and roleplaying. You don't need to get too caught up in the sample lines your character folio gave you.

spans.text: Relax, Helix. In an RPG, everyone has their own way of playing and roleplaying. You don't need to get too caught up in the sample lines your character folio gave you.

units.rawText: Yup! I'll do my best! I'll make sure I finish my mission in the game!
units.displayText: Yup! I'll do my best! I'll make sure I finish my mission in the game!

spans.text: Yup! I'll do my best! I'll make sure I finish my mission in the game!

units.rawText: As I look at her eagerly-clenched fists, and those bright, earnest eyes of hers... I realize that she probably didn't understand a single thing I said.
units.displayText: As I look at her eagerly-clenched fists, and those bright, earnest eyes of hers... I realize that she probably didn't understand a single thing I said.

spans.text: As I look at her eagerly-clenched fists, and those bright, earnest eyes of hers... I realize that she probably didn't understand a single thing I said.

units.rawText: In any case, let's take a break for now. Get some water and relax.
units.displayText: In any case, let's take a break for now. Get some water and relax.

spans.text: In any case, let's take a break for now. Get some water and relax.

units.rawText: O-Okay.
units.displayText: O-Okay.

spans.text: O-Okay.

units.rawText: Helix's trembling hand reaches out, but she's too nervous, and her fingers slip—
units.displayText: Helix's trembling hand reaches out, but she's too nervous, and her fingers slip—

spans.text: Helix's trembling hand reaches out, but she's too nervous, and her fingers slip—

units.rawText: Clunk! The glass hits the table and rolls off the side.
units.displayText: Clunk! The glass hits the table and rolls off the side.

spans.text: Clunk! The glass hits the table and rolls off the side.

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: As expected, the water inside spills all over the table and begins spreading all over its surface.
units.displayText: As expected, the water inside spills all over the table and begins spreading all over its surface.

spans.text: As expected, the water inside spills all over the table and begins spreading all over its surface.

units.rawText: Uwaaaahhhh! Tissues! Where are the tissues!
units.displayText: Uwaaaahhhh! Tissues! Where are the tissues!

spans.text: Uwaaaahhhh! Tissues! Where are the tissues!

units.rawText: She's a serious girl, but she's as careless as ever.
units.displayText: She's a serious girl, but she's as careless as ever.

spans.text: She's a serious girl, but she's as careless as ever.

units.rawText: Still, she's always been very reliable when push comes to shove. <size=28>Ah... Oh no...</size>
units.displayText: Still, she's always been very reliable when push comes to shove. Ah... Oh no...

spans.text: Still, she's always been very reliable when push comes to shove.
Ah... Oh no...
